desc:
A free Roblox rhythm game inspired by Just Shapes & Beats by Berzerk Studio (go support the original!). Dodge, dash, and survive through levels built around the music!

Every song is a new challenge, with hazards and attacks that move to the beat. Play solo, bring bots, or join up to 8 players and try to make it through together.

Between songs, vote on what to play next and choose from random modifiers that can completely change the round. Pass a ticking bomb between players, survive with one hit, compete for stars, and deal with whatever else gets thrown into the mix!

Create and publish your own charts with the Chart Editor, or play levels made by other players through Community.

New songs, modifiers, charts, and challenges will continue to be added.

Hear the beat. Watch the patterns. Don't get hit.

PC, Console, and Mobile supported. Chart Editor is PC only.

All items in game can be earned through gameplay.

Inspired by Just Shapes And Beats, Geometry Dash and Beat Saber.
